name: Fate-Born Sorcery (Metamagic)
body:
Your destiny allows you to achieve greater and greater success.

Prerequisite: Destined bloodline sorcerer or angel subtype

Benefit: A number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier you can increase the random effect portion of a spell by 25% though it cannot exceed the maximum normal possible outcome of the spell. A fate-born sorcery spell uses up a spell slot equal to that spell’s actual level.
